compound_route: Quercetin glycosides as adjunct to resistance training
recommendation: Retain formulation-specific conditional human-strength reserve; no current replacement nomination.
bub1b_variant_efficacy: Not established; no BUBR1 protein/fidelity experiment in the selected clinical studies.

identity.exact_active: Quercetin glycosides enzymatically manufactured by San-Ei Gen F.F.I. from isoquercitrin prepared from quercetin-3-O-rutinoside
identity.main_daily_preparation: 200 mg glycosides plus 1.8 g dextrin in two capsules; placebo 2.0 g dextrin; six weeks
unknown: Complete glycoside composition and batch purity
Interchangeability with CHEMBL50 aglycone, isoquercitrin alone, D+Q phytosome or arbitrary retail products
identity.matching_policy: Only exact quercetin glycoside/glycosides aliases; no automatic quercetin-aglycone or enzymatically-modified-isoquercitrin product join.

main.design: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled added-supplement contrast under common resistance training; no no-exercise arms.
main.training: Six weeks, three times weekly, bilateral isometric knee extension, three sets of ten contractions,60% PRE MVF; nativeFig1 POST one week after intervention.
main.outcome_summary: Between-treatment primary strength improvement; no added physical-fitness/mass/thickness benefit.
main.ratio_limit: Percent of PRE, not percent increase or ratio of group means. No reconstructed participant outcomes.

MU.limits: Motor units are not independent randomized people; hierarchical pooled-unit analysis not described. Tracking within-arm changes and correlation do not prove treatment contrast or mediation.

main.harms: No systematic AE table or explicit zero-event result in reviewed main; cannot infer safety from unreported harms.
source_issues: Abstract repeats20-40% for high recruitment threshold; Methods and native figures specify40-60%.
Table2 footnote printsP<.50; Results suppliesP<.001 for both MVF within-arm changes.
One Results fitness sentence denies time effects; Table2/Discussion report TUG time effects.
Table2 says two-way ANCOVA; Methods PRE covariate description names strength/thickness/mass but does not fully specify fitness-test model.

registry.limit: Registration after listed followup; does not substantiate prospective outcome hierarchy. Cluster label conflicts with paper individual dynamic allocation. Results/AE fields blank; no full protocol/history review.

counterevidence.preparation: 200 or500mg/day glycosides, same described enzymatic manufacturing route; matched capsules; arbitrary formulation equivalence not inferred.
counterevidence.regimen: 24weeks40% estimated1-RM machine training,3days/week; different endpoint and adults50-74.
counterevidence.strength_missingness: Six observations missing, including four atweek24placebo. Nominal16/arm is not complete observations at each visit. Indirect1-RM method.

stiffness_secondary_positive.meaning: Passive-stiffness measurement; not demonstrated greater strength or histological fibrosis reversal.

counterevidence.safety_limits: No severe events or attributed supplement side effects reported; incidence not significantly different. Small adult safety set does not prove pediatric/long-term safety.

erratum.correction: Removed placebo-versus-itself asterisk in Table2 fully flexed SWV change row. Inspected XML relevant row corrected.

counterevidence.funding: Conflict statement reports Suntory Wellness funding, four employee authors and design/data/analysis/writing involvement; separate funding statement says no specific grant.

fidelity_pointer_scope.PMID21632981: Complete abstract only: HepG2 phenotypic/transcriptomic genotoxicity comparison; quercetin showed genotoxicity-like effects. Database decreasedBUB1B mRNA sign not independently primary-verified.
fidelity_pointer_scope.PMID15309432: Complete abstract only: Caco-2 5or50micromolar48h expression/proliferation;50micromolar proliferation51.3%control. Database increasedBUB1B mRNA sign not independently primary-verified.
fidelity_pointer_scope.conclusion: No qualified BUBR1 protein/fidelity rescue; no global absence or universal clinical harm claim.

competition.niacin: Quercetin glycosides have a controlled strength positive; niacin is not proven superior and keeps a distinct restoration hypothesis. Neither MVA-proven.
competition.apitegromab: Current appraisal has stronger disease-associated pediatric motor-function foundation.
competition.creatine: Current appraisal is more disease-proximate via pediatric neuromuscular trials with mixed strength findings.
competition.decision: Conditional glycoside-specific reserve. No cross-trial numeric ranking or head-to-head claim.
